0022600028.text: The Mavericks (4-4, 2-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Utah Jazz in Dallas's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, a regular-season Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Utah (1-7, 1-4 at home, on a six-game losing streak) is 14th in the West and 5.5 games back in the Northwest, and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Dallas winning the last meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea, and Tarik Biberovic, with Max Christie listed as day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic, and Trey Alexander.
